engagements.title: Your Git Repo Is Not a Backup: Kubernetes Disaster Recovery with Flux and Velero
engagements.organizer: CNCF, co-located with KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America
engagements.venue: Salt Palace Convention Center, Grand Ballroom H
engagements.abstract: A cluster gets broken on purpose and brought back live with Flux and Velero. Git gives you your manifests back. It does not give you your database volumes or your secrets, and that gap is where most recovery plans quietly fail.

engagements.title: Closing the Ma (間): Filling the Gaps in Kubernetes Visibility with Headlamp
engagements.abstract: Headlamp plugins that put Flux reconciliation state and OpenCost spend in the same view as the workloads they describe. Presented in English with Japanese slides.

engagements.title: A Tag Is a Lie
engagements.abstract: Approving a container image by tag approves something that can change after you approved it. Pinning by digest belongs in policy, as an evidence control, not in a style guide.

engagements.title: From Buckets to Native Histograms: Lessons from a Production Migration
engagements.abstract: A phased move from classic to native histograms on Prometheus 3.x: running both side by side, checking PromQL results against each other, what changes in the WAL and TSDB, and the Grafana dashboards and exporters that break along the way.

engagements.title: Speaker buddy and city guide
engagements.organizer: CNCG Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Rajkot and Vadodara
engagements.abstract: Looked after speakers on the day, and wrote the Ahmedabad guide the organizers sent to every speaker with their pass.

engagements.title: Agents in the Dark
engagements.event: Cloud Native Vadodara September Meetup, KCD Gujarat pre-event
engagements.abstract: An incident-investigation agent built on the Claude Agent SDK, with an OpenTelemetry span for every model turn and tool call, traced through Prometheus, Loki, Tempo and Grafana while it chases a database connection-pool incident.

engagements.title: Build, Containerize and Deploy
engagements.organizer: AWS Student Builder Group at Parul University, with KCD Gujarat and CNCG Ahmedabad
engagements.abstract: A small Node.js app taken the whole cloud-native path live on stage: build it, put it in a container, deploy it to Kubernetes, then watch Kubernetes scale it under load and bring it back after a crash.

engagements.title: Organizing team, RRU campus round
engagements.event: FinSpark'26, Bank of Maharashtra national cybersecurity hackathon
engagements.organizer: id8nxt with SITAICS, Rashtriya Raksha University

engagements.title: Docker's AI Revolution: From Containers to Agents, What's Next in 2026?
engagements.abstract: A live demo of Compose for agents, MCP, cagent and microVM sandboxes, and what they change about how agents get built and run.

engagements.title: OpenSearch: From Zero to Dashboards in 30 Minutes
engagements.abstract: From an empty cluster to working dashboards in one sitting.

engagements.title: How Not to Become a Grafana Champion
Level Up Your Monitoring: Grafana 101 for Everyone
engagements.event: Cloud Native Ahmedabad x Grafana Ahmedabad cross meetup
engagements.organizer: CNCG Ahmedabad and Grafana & Friends Ahmedabad

roles.title: Co-organizer
roles.summary: Runs the Ahmedabad chapter of Grafana's community meetup with Viral Parmar. Talks on observability, OpenTelemetry and the LGTM stack, hosted by a different local company each time.

roles.title: Community team
roles.summary: Was part of the volunteer team behind the CNCF community group in Gandhinagar.

roles.title: Chapter team
roles.summary: Helps the core team run Docker Ahmedabad meetups.

topics.title: Kubernetes disaster recovery that survives a real restore
topics.summary: What Git can and cannot bring back, and how Flux and Velero cover the rest. Live failure, live recovery.

topics.title: Migrating to Prometheus native histograms
topics.summary: Running classic and native histograms side by side, proving the queries agree, and the dashboards that break on the way.

topics.title: Observability for AI agents
topics.summary: Tracing every model turn and tool call with OpenTelemetry so an agent's decisions can be debugged like any other service.

topics.title: Containers for agents
topics.summary: Compose for agents, MCP and sandboxed runtimes, shown as a working demo rather than a roadmap slide.

topics.title: Supply chain evidence an auditor can trust
topics.summary: Why a mutable tag is not an approval, and what to enforce in policy instead.

topics.title: Cloud native from zero, for students
topics.summary: One app from laptop to container to Kubernetes, with the failure each step fixes shown live.

topics.title: Observability from zero, for beginners
topics.summary: Grafana or OpenSearch, from an empty install to a dashboard people actually use, in one session.
